decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment,  Drawing Numbers 2010-14 4, 2010-16 1, 2010-16 2, 2010-16 5, 2010-16 7, 2010-16 8, 2010-16 9, 2010-16 10, 2010-16 15A, 2010-16 6b, 2010-16 17, 2010-16 6, received 06/09/10.2010-16 12e, 2010-16 13b, 2010-16 14c, 2010-15 15b, 2010-16 16f, 2010-16 18a, 2010-16 20b, received 15/11/10) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the development a description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the repair and alteration of the existing timber frame, including any additional elements to be inserted, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme.
Condition : 5 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 6 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Further details of all internal plumbing, drainage, pipework and any works to the service conduit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - No works shall take place until details of the method of fire protection of  the doors, including 1:20 scale elevations and sections of doors have beensubmitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where possible, all existing original doors shall be retained and where they are required to be upgraded to meet fire regulations details of upgrading works shall be submitted to and approvedin writing by the Local Planning Authority. Self-closing mechanisms, if required, shall be of the concealed mortice type. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - No works shall take place until samples of the materials (including details of repointing and window frames) to be used in the construction of works hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordancewith the approved details.
Condition : 10 - The finishes of the works hereby permitted shall match in material, colour, style, bonding and texture those of the existing building.
description: Listed Building Consent for lowering floor level of basement, extension and alterations to front and rear lightwells including openings and floor levels, internal alterations to all floors and replacement, renovation and enlargement of several windows including insertion of door to rear.
